title: Harsil Valley & Gartang Gali
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.
highlights: Gartang Gali trek from Lanka Bridge (2.5 km)
Lama Top trek (2.5 km) and Bagori Village
Khedi waterfall on the way to Harsil
overview:
A long weekend in the upper Bhagirathi valley: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Harsil Valley and Gartang Gali group trip leaves Delhi in the evening and travels overnight. The departure time and location are shared once your booking is confirmed.

Day 1 reaches Uttarkashi in the morning for breakfast, stops at Khedi waterfall and gets to Harsil by evening for a bonfire and dinner. Day 2 covers the 2.5 km Gartang Gali trek from Lanka Bridge, Gangotri Temple and Surya Kund. Day 3 is the 2.5 km trek to Lama Top and a visit to Bagori Village before the late-afternoon drive back, reaching Delhi early the next morning. AC transport, 2 nights in Harsil, 2 breakfasts, 2 dinners, Gangotri registration and a trip coordinator are included. Prices start at ₹9,499 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi
itinerary.content:
The departure time and location are shared once your booking is confirmed.
Depart for Harsil.
Overnight journey from Delhi to Harsil.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi and reach Harsil Valley
itinerary.content:
Reach Uttarkashi by morning. Freshen up and have breakfast.
Resume the journey to Harsil Valley, with a stop at Khedi waterfall on the way.
Reach Harsil in the evening.
Check in at the campsite or homestay. There is a short 500-metre trek to the homestay.
Explore the local Harsil village if time permits.
Enjoy a bonfire in the evening, followed by dinner.
Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gartang Gali, Gangotri and Surya Kund
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Drive to Lanka Bridge, where the Gartang Gali trek starts. The trek is 2.5 km. Gartang Gali is a skywalk near the Indo-China border.
Head to Gangotri Temple. Gangotri is a small town in Uttarkashi with the temple of Goddess Ganga at its heart.
Visit Surya Kund, a short trek near Gangotri.
Return to the stay in Harsil.
Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Lama Top and Bagori Village | Return to Delhi
itinerary.content:
Wake up early in the morning and have breakfast.
Trek to Lama Top, a 2.5 km trek.
Visit Bagori Village.
Board the vehicle for Delhi in the late afternoon.
Stop for dinner on the way, around Rishikesh or Chamba.
Reach Delhi early the next morning, where the trip ends.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi in the evening and travels overnight towards Harsil. The departure time and location are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Harsil Valley & Gartang Gali trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹9,499 per person on quad sharing, ₹10,999 on triple sharing and ₹11,499 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

AC transportation from Delhi to Delhi, 2 nights in Harsil in a homestay or hotel, sightseeing as per the itinerary, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, Gangotri registration, a bonfire, a trip coordinator and 24x7 support. Lunches, parking and monument entry fees are not included.

Day 2 has the Gartang Gali trek, 2.5 km starting from Lanka Bridge, and a short trek to Surya Kund near Gangotri. Day 3 has the 2.5 km trek to Lama Top. There is also a short 500-metre trek to the homestay on arrival.
Both nights are in Harsil, in a homestay or hotel. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing, and early check-in is not included.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
